from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, traceback
from pathlib import Path
from experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.family_campaign_executor import run_slot
from experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.family_partition_worker import run_partition
out, base, config = [Path(os.environ[key]) for key in ("OUT", "BASE", "CONFIG")]
rank = int(os.environ["JOB_COMPLETION_INDEX"])
def write(name, value):
    with (out / name).open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n"); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
receipt = {
    "rank": rank, "source_commit": "68b9e1004ef289d320bfbdbfdf272b2c3cd9440d",
    "config_sha256": hashlib.sha256(config.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "job_uid": os.environ["JOB_UID"], "pod_uid": os.environ["POD_UID"],
    "pod": os.environ["POD_NAME"], "gpu_uuid": os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"],
    "started_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "model_requests": 0, "behavioral_episodes": 0, "release_permitted": False,
}
write("launch.json", receipt)
def guarded_slot(**kwargs):
    family = json.loads(kwargs["campaign_path"].read_text())["family"].lower()
    probe = out / "gpu_rechecks" / f"{family}-{kwargs['index']:03d}.json"
    idle = subprocess.run([
        os.environ["PY"], "-m", "experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.gpu_idle_probe",
        "--expected-count", "1", "--output", str(probe),
    ], text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
    if idle.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"pre-slot GPU idle probe failed: {idle.stderr}")
    if idle.stdout.strip() != os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"]:
        raise RuntimeError("pre-slot GPU identity differs from locked allocation")
    return run_slot(**kwargs)
try:
    result = run_partition(config_path=config, rank=rank, root=base / "workers" / str(rank),
                           slot_runner=guarded_slot)
    receipt["worker_result"] = result
    if result["status"] != "complete":
        raise RuntimeError("partition stopped before its complete frozen slice")
    receipt["status"] = "complete_zero_model_qualification_partition_not_release"
except BaseException:
    receipt.update(status="infrastructure_stopped_partition", traceback=traceback.format_exc())
    raise
finally:
    receipt["finished_at_utc"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    write("process_outcome.json", receipt)
PY
